blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to Higher Education & Universities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Universities balance teaching quality, research output and financial sustainability: student-success analytics, research computing, administrative automation and campus economics. The constraint is governance — faculty senate, ethics boards and student privacy all bind.

items: Sensitive research attracts state interest; campus controls loose.
LMS/SIS/support data siloed; at-risk students found at failure.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Cloud Security & Posture Management from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Student success/advising, Research computing, Accreditation evidence) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/GDPR-class among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Evidence once, audit anywhere: compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify: zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace: intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Classification-aware access for sensitive programs (export posture evidenced)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: classification-aware controls for sensitive research programs (export-control posture evidenced). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
